subject.title: cli-backend agent runs against anthropic (claude-cli runtime) return 401 authentication_failed while identical claude invocation works in shell

question: Should maintainers treat this as an OpenClaw-managed Claude CLI runtime bug pending live macOS service-context proof, or close it as external Claude/Keychain setup?
rationale: The source path matches the report, but the decisive failure depends on macOS LaunchAgent, Claude CLI OAuth, Keychain/file credential state, and live MCP behavior that cannot be safely resolved from this Linux read-only checkout alone.

options.title: Run live macOS service-context repro
options.body: Keep the issue open and compare managed gateway cron/channel execution against same-environment Claude CLI replay with live MCP and empty MCP before changing env isolation or auth setup behavior.

options.title: Close as external setup
options.body: Close only if a maintainer can confirm the reporter's environment matches the already resolved GUI-Keychain re-auth case and no OpenClaw source change is needed.

options.title: Fold into expired-token guidance work
options.body: Use the adjacent recovery-copy PR only for user-facing error guidance, while leaving the root service-context mismatch separate unless the live repro proves it is merely expired OAuth.

recommendation.title: Run live macOS service-context repro
recommendation.body: Keep the issue open and compare managed gateway cron/channel execution against same-environment Claude CLI replay with live MCP and empty MCP before changing env isolation or auth setup behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The current history points to steipete across external CLI auth overlays, Claude CLI credential helpers, and the current carrier refactor for the affected files.
